answer: To take a seat, an applicant must finish a sequential VDF: 262144 iterations of H(epoch-seed || pubkey) and publish the transcript Merkle root before the epoch mid-tick. The ticket is bound to a ferrous cluster identifier, the union-find of all funding UTXOs that touched the key in the prior twelve epochs. A nebula of sockpuppets paid from one wallet therefore shares a single ticket; a second submission burns 200 POA and locks the cluster for two epochs. Remaining deposits vest on a juniper-slow square-root curve over six sealed answers.
